search_text: published ZDI-20-588 ZDI-CAN-10377 Schneider Electric EcoStruxure IT Gateway Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2020-05-06 CVE-2020-10626 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-10626 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Schneider Electric'] ['EcoStruxure IT Gateway'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure IT Gateway. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of files within the Temp directory. The issue results from an incorrect assignment of privilege to a critical resource. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Schneider Electric has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure IT Gateway Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure IT Gateway. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.
